PZZ700-280830-
1205 PM PST Fri Nov 27 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...
At 12 PM, a 1021 mb high was just offshore of San Francisco, and 
a 1014 mb low was over the Gulf of California. Weak to moderate 
onshore flow through Saturday switching to offshore in the 
overnight hours, along with an eddy at times. More persistent 
onshore flow returns Sunday. A Pacific storm system will move
through the area Tuesday into Wednesday, which will bring 
increased risk of gusty, potentially very strong, winds and high 
seas.

$$
